title: Live updates: Trump welcomes Xi to Washington
summary: Donald Trump welcomes Xi Jinping to the US by greeting him personally at the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews. The two are expected to discuss trade, AI, Taiwan and Iran.

image.caption: Donald and Melania Trump greet Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at Joint Base Andrews, MarylandImage: Kevin Lamarque/REUTERS

blocks.text: We are launching our coverage of the highly anticipated meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President X Jinping in Washington.
Trade, the wars in Iran and Ukraine and artificial intelligence are expected to be on the agenda as the two leaders meet.
This is Xi's first state visit to Washington in a decade.
Join us as we bring you all the updates from Xi's trip.
